steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json and admin settings schema for Brick Game Classic.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Set up Gradle build file with SDK 34, Java 8 compatibility, and zero external dependencies.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Define application manifest with orientation locking, full hardware acceleration, and standard icon.

steps.title: Create Color Palette & Theme Resources
steps.description: Define retro handheld plastic shell colors, LCD matrix tints, and control button styles.

steps.title: Create Button and Shell Drawables
steps.description: Design vector and shape drawables for tactile game buttons, D-pad, and console shell borders.

steps.title: Build Retro Audio Synthesizer
steps.description: Implement SoundManager using Android ToneGenerator for authentic 8-bit piezo buzzer sounds.

steps.title: Implement Tetromino Shapes & Game Logic Engine
steps.description: Develop full brick game logic including rotation matrix, collision detection, and line clears.

steps.title: Create Authentic LCD Screen Custom View
steps.description: Develop high-fidelity monochrome segmented LCD screen view drawing matrix cells and side panels.

steps.title: Design Handheld Console Layout
steps.description: Compose layout with authentic blue handheld casing, screen bezels, speaker grille, and arcade buttons.

steps.title: Implement Main Handheld Game Activity
steps.description: Hook up game loop, touch controls, high score persistence, and game state transitions.

steps.title: Building Brick Game Classic
steps.description: Compile debug APK using Gradle build tools.
